blocks.prompt: 8 Find the area of the triangle formed by the points \(A(-3, 2)\), \(B(4, -1)\), \(C(1, 5)\).
blocks.explanation:
Teen vertices diye hain aur area chahiye: yeh seedha 5.7 ka formula hai.
\(\Delta = \frac{1}{2}[x_1(y_2 - y_3) + x_2(y_3 - y_1) + x_3(y_1 - y_2)]\), ya determinant wala roop.
Coordinates dhyan se rakhne hain, khaas taur par negative values.
Plan: determinant likhna, expand karna, simplify, aur absolute value.
Area hamesha positive hota hai; agar formula negative de to us ki absolute value lena hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(A(-3, 2)\), \(B(4, -1)\), \(C(1, 5)\).
Maloom karna: triangle \(ABC\) ka area \(\Delta\).
Tareeqa: 5.7 ka area formula, jahan \((x_1, y_1) = (-3, 2)\), \((x_2, y_2) = (4, -1)\), \((x_3, y_3) = (1, 5)\).

Determinant likhein
\[\Delta = \dfrac{1}{2}\begin{vmatrix} -3 & 2 & 1 \\ 4 & -1 & 1 \\ 1 & 5 & 1 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: har row mein ek vertex aur aakhir mein 1.

Simplify karein
\[\Delta = \tfrac{1}{2}(33) = \dfrac{33}{2} = 16.5\]
Kyun: jawab positive hai (vertices anticlockwise hain), is liye yahi area hai.

Tasdeeq:
Shoelace tareeqe se \(A \to B \to C\): \((-3)(-1) - 4(2) = -5\), \(4(5) - 1(-1) = 21\), \(1(2) - (-3)(5) = 17\); jama \(= 33\), aadha \(= 16.5\) \(\checkmark\)
Do alag tareeqon se ek hi jawab aaya. Area ki unit 'square units' likhna mat bhooliye.
